name: Adaptive-Scale and Spectral-Aware NeRF
aliases: NeRF combining adaptive scaling with spectral perception
definition: A NeRF variant that integrates an adaptive scale function to adjust sample point contributions and a spectral decoder to handle multispectral information (including infrared and ultraviolet) for improved color fidelity and realism in 3D toy reconstruction.
summary: Adaptive-Scale and Spectral-Aware NeRF is a neural radiance field variant that improves color fidelity by integrating an adaptive scale function to modulate sample contributions and a spectral decoder to handle multispectral information.
